subject: Re: Quick playbook — regional field webinar surge plan
body_summary: Coordination thread for a partner-sponsored inbound webinar: finalize RSVP audience segments, tracking links, sponsor placement in invite, and sponsor materials delivery windows.
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Field webinar — 'Serving LLMs at Scale' (partner ops & RSVP plan)

Team,

Quick kickoff for the Acme co-hosted webinar on Sept 26. We need to lock the RSVP journey and sponsor placement by end of day Friday so design and Deliverables can complete assets. Key asks: audience targeting, tracking link sheet finalization, RSVP reminder cadence, and where Acme logo / callout appears in the invite.

Proposed start state:
- 3 target segments: Engineers (tag: eng_prod), Platform/infra leads (tag: infra_arch), Product managers (tag: pm_growth)
- Invite 1: primary invite with early-bird CTA + demo preview video (send date 8/30)
- Reminder 1: 1 week after invite (9/6) — short, value-driven
- Reminder 2: 72 hours before event (9/23) — urgency + calendar add
- Tracking: one HubSpot campaign with UTM per segment + per CTAs; sheet attached (tracking_links_sheet.csv)

Open questions:
1) Marissa — can you map the exact audience counts per tag? we want >3k send across all segments but staggered windows to control RSVP rate.
2) Ben — what tracking tokens do we need for Acme's reporting? they requested a separate click feed.
3) Lauren — can design host the sponsor logo pack placement (top right and sponsor blurb below speaker list)?

Attachments: agenda_v2.pdf, tracking_links_sheet.csv (see Drive link in related links).

If we can agree on the cadence and the final tracking tab today I will publish the invite copy by EOD and route to legal for sponsor language signoff.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field webinar — 'Serving LLMs at Scale' (partner ops & RSVP plan)

On Wed, Aug 22, 2028 at 9:14 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team,
>
> Quick kickoff for the Acme co-hosted webinar on Sept 26. We need to lock the RSVP journey and sponsor placement by end of day Friday so design and Deliverables can complete assets. Key asks: audience targeting, tracking link sheet finalization, RSVP reminder cadence, and where Acme logo / callout appears in the invite.

Thanks Markus — updated read below. I pulled current tag counts from Outreach and added a recommended send split for performance testing (A/B send windows for engineers):
- eng_prod: 1,450 (send 8/30 + small top-up 9/5)
- infra_arch: 780 (single send 8/30)
- pm_growth: 980 (single send 8/31 to avoid overlap with product launch comms)

Recommendation on cadence tweak: replace the 1 week reminder with a short peer testimonial nudge (single quote from platform engineer + 1-line use case) — higher lift but better conversion. I updated the tracking_links_sheet.csv row for eng_prod with two UTMs for the A/B windows.

Design notes for Lauren: place the Acme logo inline with host logos at the top, and include a 2-line sponsor blurb in the footer. No co-branding in hero image unless Elena confirms a 2-color lockup (legal will need to see).

I'll sync with Demand Gen on subject-line tests after we lock assets.

Marissa
Senior Events Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@acme.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field webinar — 'Serving LLMs at Scale' (partner ops & RSVP plan)

Hi Markus + Marissa,

Thanks for the clear kickoff. We can confirm sponsor placement at the top with the host logos and the footer blurb — we will not request hero co-branding. I attached the final logo pack (sponsor_logo_pack.zip) to our shared Drive folder; high-res and monochrome options included.

Two asks from Acme:
- Please add a dedicated UTM parameter "utm_partner=acme" so our analytics team can stitch conversions across the funnel.
- Can you include a small "Sponsored by Acme" line under the speaker list on the landing page? Not on the invite subject or top-level hero.

We can sign the sponsorship addendum once we approve invite copy. Is DocuSign the preferred flow? If so, send the link and we'll route to legal.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, Acme AI

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@acme.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@datainc.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field webinar — 'Serving LLMs at Scale' (partner ops & RSVP plan)

Great — thanks everyone for the quick turn. Final decisions and actions below: 

Decisions:
- Audience sends / cadence: follow Marissa's split and A/B window for eng_prod. Send dates: 8/30 (primary), 9/05 (eng top-up), 8/31 (pm_growth), infra 8/30. Reminders 9/06 (testimonial nudge) and 9/23 (72-hr urgency).
- Tracking: add utm_partner=acme plus the UTM variants in the attached tracking_links_sheet.csv. Ben to provide click feed mapping to Acme by EOD Thursday.
- Sponsor placement: top-right among host logos + footer blurb + "Sponsored by Acme" on landing page under the speaker list only. No hero co-branding.

Action items:
- Marissa: finalize subject-line variants and hand to Demand Gen by 8/24.
- Ben: produce the click feed and update tracking_links_sheet.csv with Acme token by 8/24.
- Lauren: produce final invite creative with logo placement and sponsor blurb ready for legal review by 8/25.
- Markus: send DocuSign sponsorship addendum link to Elena after Marissa pushes invite copy to legal.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign?doc=8462 (placeholder)
Drive assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-invite-assets
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/record/HS-58214

I'll follow up with a short mutual action plan doc if anything slips. Thanks for the fast alignment — this is on track.

-Markus
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: agenda_v2.pdf, tracking_links_sheet.csv, sponsor_logo_pack.zip
